assumptions: Adjacent fixed-length big-endian scalars, shared start, no arbitrary XOR/split/endian or wide payload scan; format unknown, finite interpretation only
cipher_parameters: No new AES password trials; inputs are already recorded and audited padding-valid plaintexts
estimate_basis: Planning estimate 10000 derivations/sec; actual runtime measured in result, not a benchmark claim
gate: Exact target address, then independent pure-Python EC/address verification; halt before publishing matching scalar
reasoning: The independently decoded checkerboard refers to two private keys; each 80-byte AES ciphertext admits 64..79 unpadded bytes, enough for two adjacent 32-byte scalars plus at most 15 bytes of metadata
transformation: For every saved padding hit in the two 80-byte ciphertexts, test all 0..15 prefix lengths admitting two contiguous 32-byte big-endian keys; remainder treated as metadata, not manually removed
